consent_startup.message: While the background process checks saved consent, a short memory buffer holds reduced resource/header metadata only. It is used only if prior consent is confirmed; otherwise it is discarded, never restored by later acceptance.

consent_intro.message: Observation is off until you agree. Detect.Expert processes data on your device to inspect website API use. No reports or telemetry are uploaded to the developer.

consent_reports.message: Browsing and resource metadata, API activity and counts are retained in browser session storage. A separate WebRTC history includes configured ICE-server hostnames/IPs and ports. Pro recording starts only on your command. Settings remain in local storage.

consent_previews.message: Local previews can copy Canvas/WebGL images already read by a page, exact technical API values, WebRTC certificate fingerprints and Google X-Client-Data. Images and page titles may contain personal or sensitive information. Images, Google headers stay in bounded memory, outside browser storage, Pro/PDF and exports. When Pro recording is running, selected technical API parameters and distinct returned values are retained in its local report.

consent_controls.message: After enabling, browser-permitted sites are observed automatically in the selected scope. You can narrow or disable the scope, pause or clear results, and withdraw consent in settings. Previously opened pages need a reload. Optional API denials require separate activation. Saved JSON/PDF files remain under your control.

consent_error.message: Could not update observation settings. Try again.

consent_saved.message: This version of the data disclosure has been accepted on this device.

google_ids_meaning.message: Chrome experiment IDs, not a proven unique device or user ID. This value does not establish tracking or the cause of a CAPTCHA.

google_ids_source.message: Browser-observed outgoing header (onSendHeaders), not proof of server receipt. Exact values stay only in RAM/Light, outside storage, Pro/PDF and export.

google_ids_not_present.message: X-Client-Data was absent from this destination's last observed request headers.

google_ids_unavailable.message: No current header value is available. This does not establish that no header was sent.

google_ids_too_large.message: The header exceeded the 4096-character preview limit; its value was not retained.

google_ids_invalid.message: The header was duplicated or its representation was unsupported; no value was retained.

google_ids_decode_unknown.message: The observed header is shown unchanged; its protobuf contents could not be decoded.

google_ids_decode_limited.message: Decoding is partial: unknown fields or the 256-ID limit. Experiment names and uniqueness are not inferred.

google_ids_empty.message: No eligible Google request has been observed for this document in the current memory period.

google_ids_limited.message: Some requests or values were omitted or expired. The displayed list is incomplete.

google_ids_scope.message: Fixed HTTPS Google destinations only, with access to the destination and initiator. Last headers for up to eight hosts, not a global browser ID. Navigation capture requires existing all-sites access and unambiguous browser events within two seconds. Chrome-internal traffic and inaccessible frames are not covered. Values expire after ten minutes and disappear on clear, pause, access change or service-worker restart. Chrome normally omits its variations header in Incognito. No flags, cookies or CAPTCHA scores are read.

api_note_webrtc.message: Calls and state reads do not prove a connection, hardware identification or tracking. Certificate generation and short offer/read/close sequences are also used by ordinary applications.

rtc_values_returned.message: Selected fields returned to the website

rtc_values_limited.message: Some fields or observations were omitted by the privacy or data limits.

rtc_values_empty.message: No selected fields are available in this observation.

rtc_values_certificate.message: This fingerprint identifies a certificate, not a device. Reusing it may link connections, but does not prove tracking. Selected technical results are retained locally during Pro recording.

rtc_values_storage.message: Only direct certificate objects are recognized. A returned IndexedDB write request does not prove transaction commit or persistence across visits. Nested records are not inspected.

rtc_values_scope.message: Selected synchronous results only. Promise results, stats iteration, full SDP, ICE passwords, device IDs and network DTLS handshakes are not inspected. Extra certificate snapshots are labelled separately. Selected technical results are retained locally during Pro recording.

api_note_media_capabilities.message: Players, editors and calls check codec compatibility. RTP getCapabilities creates no connection. Selected returned codec fields may appear in the result preview; they do not establish a hardware model or successful playback.

api_note_media_devices.message: Listing devices, checking settings and requesting capture are distinct. A call does not prove permission or recording. Selected returned track settings may appear locally; device IDs, labels and media contents are excluded.

api_note_speech.message: Speech and accessibility features also query voices and recognition availability. Voice lists, languages and audio are not read. Calling install does not prove a package download completed.

api_note_drm.message: DRM and HDCP checks support protected playback. A request does not prove tracking, license delivery or a device protection level; configurations and licenses are not inspected.

api_note_device_access.message: getDevices/getPorts request the list available to the site; requestDevice/requestPort request selection or access. Call counts are not device counts. IDs and response contents are excluded.

api_note_browser_capabilities.message: Environment and permission-state checks are observed. cpuPerformance reports a category, not a CPU measurement. Arguments and lists are not read; repeated queries do not prove distinct-permission enumeration or fingerprinting.

api_note_builtin_ai.message: AI availability, creation and use are distinct. Calls do not prove a GPU, a downloaded model or data transfer. Text, language pairs and outputs are not read; Promise completion is unknown.

api_note_recognition.message: Recognition depends on the browser and platform. A capability query or detect call does not prove a face or user was recognized. Images, handwriting, text and format lists are not read.

api_note_app_integration.message: App, file, lock and background APIs have ordinary uses. A call does not prove an installed app, tab count, file access or Trusted Types enforcement. Contents, paths and callbacks are not inspected.

headers_note.message: Facts from completed responses observed by the browser in the accessible document. Each header counts once per response. Values, reporting addresses and session keys are excluded; browser enforcement is unconfirmed.

headers_observation.message: The browser observed selected response headers.

headers_interpretation.message: A header's presence does not prove data transfer or covert tracking.

headers_truncated.message: Observation is incomplete: some responses or hint names were omitted. Counts are lower bounds.

headers_client_hints_note.message: The server requests client hints; actual transmission is not established.

headers_policy_note.message: The policy restricts capabilities; it does not grant permission.

headers_reporting_note.message: Browser reporting configuration, not proof of a report being sent.

headers_session_note.message: Session-binding mechanism; values and keys are hidden, registration is unconfirmed.

headers_dictionary_note.message: Compression dictionary declaration; use is unconfirmed.

api_webnn_coverage_note.message: Coverage is limited to 44 API entry points when present, including selected graph operators, not all of WebNN. Workers and internal computations are not observed; a missing entry does not prove no call occurred.

api_note_webnn.message: WebNN capability checks can select a compatible model. Context requests, build and dispatch do not establish the selected hardware, completion, or fingerprinting. Options, support matrices, tensor contents and Worker activity are not inspected.

api_preview_webnn.message: Only scalar metadata already read by the page can appear here. Tensor shapes and data and support-matrix contents are excluded; async completion is unknown. Counts describe calls, not graph nodes or completed inferences.

api_preview_audio.message: Preview may include sample rate, latency and channel counts. Samples and hashes are excluded; calls do not prove fingerprinting or microphone access.

api_preview_webgpu.message: Browser-returned information may be limited or generalized. It is not independent verification of a GPU model. No active GPU tests or shader timing are performed.

api_preview_wasm.message: Only JavaScript API results are shown. Module bytes and internal execution are not inspected; CPU, architecture and SIMD are not established.

api_preview_window_management.message: Screen and window values already read by the page. Calling getScreenDetails does not prove permission was granted or a complete monitor list was obtained.

api_preview_compute_pressure.message: Coarse states read by the page. Exact timestamps are hidden; activity in other tabs and cooling characteristics are not established.

api_preview_idle_detection.message: Latest state read by the page. Calling start does not confirm an active subscription. Presence history and departure or return times are not recorded.

api_preview_display.message: Latest dimensions and scale actually returned to the page. The extension does not request a monitor list itself.

api_preview_cpu.message: hardwareConcurrency is the browser's estimate of available logical processors, not the number of physical CPU cores.

api_preview_memory.message: Device Memory reports an approximate memory category, not the exact amount of installed RAM.

api_results_note.message: Latest observed results. When Pro recording is running, selected technical parameters and distinct returned values are retained in its local report.

api_results_truncated.message: Some results are unavailable due to capture or delivery limits.

protection_risk.message: API refusals can break websites, sign-in, editors and calls. Custom rules may make your browser more distinctive. No anonymity or complete protection is guaranteed.

protection_consent.message: I understand the risk of broken websites and want to enable blocking.

protection_host_note.message: This exact hostname, HTTP and HTTPS, all ports. Subdomains and third-party frames have their own rules; this is not a whole-tab exception.

protection_removed.message: API entry points removed; restore by reloading.

protection_limits.message: Only the listed APIs and authorized HTTP(S) documents. Workers, inherited-origin frames, retained references and page interference remain gaps. JavaScript client-hint blocking does not remove HTTP headers. Counts come from the page-controlled MAIN world, not proof of protection.

protection_restore_reload.message: Turn off for this site and reload

visual_webgl_empty.message: No supported WebGL image was captured in this document. Parameter and extension queries do not return pixels. A preview requires the page to read or export an image within the supported formats and capture limits.

visual_gallery_note.message: First supported image per canvas; labels describe observed calls, not pixel comparisons. 2D does not prove CPU rendering, and WebGL does not prove hardware acceleration. Ordinary graphics use the same operations.

visual_gallery_limited.message: Some images or updates were omitted: capture time, format, delivery or memory limits. This gallery is incomplete.

visual_op_flip_back_copy.message: Y reflection on source and copy

api_note_audio.message: Context creation, node operations, offline rendering calls and data reads are shown separately. Rendering completion is not observed. Samples, spectra and hashes are not retained. Players and editors also use these APIs; calls alone do not prove fingerprinting or microphone access.

extension_targets_note.message: These extension resources were referenced in the page context. This may check their presence or support an ordinary integration. Installation, outcome and caller identity are unknown; the data is page controlled.

extension_targets_unknown_note.message: Counts are accesses, not unique extensions. Unknown target IDs and resource paths are not retained.

extension_targets_reference.message: Assigning src does not confirm that a request was sent.

extension_targets_limited.message: This list is incomplete: some accesses may be missing.

extension_targets_empty_filter.message: No targets in this category appear in the list.

local_ports_unknown.message: Port numbers were not retained for these attempts.

local_ports_incomplete.message: This list is incomplete: some port numbers may be missing.

api_actions_note.message: These are specific calls or property reads observed in this document. Their phase is shown separately. A call does not prove successful access or fingerprinting; these page-controlled observations may be forged.

api_window_events_note.message: Listener counts represent registration/removal calls and handler assignments, including clearing, not active listeners or delivered events. Window and fullscreen calls do not confirm placement. Their arguments and options are not inspected.

api_pressure_limits_note.message: sampleInterval=0 requests notifications when the state changes, not a guaranteed rate. Options, callback delivery and subscription duration are not inspected. Delivery depends on focus, policy and browser limits.

api_note_webgpu.message: The listed operations distinguish adapter information, feature and limit access, and shader or pipeline creation. Browsers may restrict or generalize GPU details. Selected technical results are retained locally during Pro recording. Calls do not establish an exact GPU model, a complete profile or shader timing.

api_note_wasm.message: The page called WebAssembly APIs to validate, compile or instantiate code, or access memory. Module bytes and internal execution are not inspected. CPU timing, SIMD features, architecture, a forged User-Agent or Lockdown Mode are not established.

api_note_client_hints.message: getHighEntropyValues requests additional browser or system information. Chrome normally shows no permission prompt, but policy and implementation may limit the response. Ordinary compatibility checks can request the same fields; the call is not proof of fingerprinting.

api_note_window_management.message: getScreenDetails requests screen information and may require window-management permission. Access to screens, currentScreen and individual properties is listed separately. Selected technical results are retained locally during Pro recording. A request does not prove permission was granted or reveal a workplace.

api_note_compute_pressure.message: Compute Pressure can provide coarse CPU pressure states. Depending on implementation, pressure can reflect more than this tab. Observer creation, observe/takeRecords calls and record reads are separate facts. Selected technical results are retained locally during Pro recording. Activity in other tabs, cooling characteristics or absence of the user are not established.

api_note_idle_detection.message: Idle Detection can expose activity and screen-lock states after permission. Creating a detector or calling start does not prove an active subscription. Selected technical results are retained locally during Pro recording.

api_hints_unknown.message: Requested fields are unknown in passive mode: the sensor does not read the argument again or iterate a page-controlled collection.

extDescription.message: Local analysis of browser APIs, fingerprinting signals and identification services, with configurable API blocking.

coverageOff.message: Not observing: no scope selected. “Not detected” means “not observed in the accessible area during the period”.

error_reload.message: Could not reload the tab. Open the page and try again.

coverage_restart_desc.message: Reload this document before restarting its sensors, then open the extension and enable observation again. To observe from page load, choose “Always on this site” before reloading.

disclaimerNoVerdict.message: No site-safety verdict. Monitoring is passive by default; optional API blocking requires explicit activation.

coverage_active_desc.message: Implemented sensors were installed at document start. This does not mean every detection method is covered.

coverage_partial_desc.message: Only part of the document is observed: $DETAIL$. No findings in inaccessible areas means nothing.

coverage_late_start_desc.message: Sensors were installed after the page started running. Early calls may have been missed. Reload the page to analyse from the start.

coverage_late_start_active_tab_desc.message: Observing calls from activation until this document is replaced. Early calls may have been missed. To observe page load, choose “Always on this site”, then reload.

coverage_paused_desc.message: Observation is paused. The page keeps working.

coverage_paused_reload.message: To remove the sensors completely, reload the page.

coverage_unsupported_title.message: Observation is not available on this page

coverage_unsupported_desc.message: Built-in Chrome pages, the Web Store, other extensions and some special frames do not support observation.

coverage_unsupported_chrome_desc.message: This Chrome version is not supported ($VERSION$). Observation is unavailable.

coverage_no_access_desc.message: No access to $HOST$. The absence of observations means nothing. Choose an observation level to start.

coverage_revoked_desc.message: Access to $HOST$ was revoked. No new data is collected. Reload the page to remove the sensors completely.

coverage_degraded_desc.message: The event limit was exceeded: some data was dropped ($DROPPED$). This period cannot be treated as fully observed.

coverage_context_changed.message: Context changed: showing the report for $HOST$.

coverage_managed_desc.message: Some settings are managed by your organisation.

coverage_blind_spots_desc.message: Math patterns: during Pro recording. Worker/Worklet, WebGPU buffers and sensors: selected API calls. Not observed: CSSOM, HTTP validators, CNAME, Wasm/worker/CSS internals, DNS, TLS and server-side checks.

inspector_dns_desc.message: Requests to different subdomains of one domain were observed in a short period. DNS tests, CDNs and cache-busting can cause this pattern. The count is a lower bound across bounded windows. Actual DNS queries, the resolver address and a DNS leak are not established.

coverage_flag_hook_failed.message: sensors reported an installation limitation; diagnostics are page-controlled

coverage_flag_channel_gap.message: page channel gap or conflict; data is page-controlled

coverage_flag_truncated.message: details truncated due to the memory limit

coverage_flag_protocol_mismatch.message: sensor version is outdated, reload the page

coverage_flag_descriptor_nonconfigurable.message: some APIs cannot be observed: protected descriptors

coverage_flag_bridge_ring_overflow.message: transfer buffer overflowed, some data was lost

coverage_flag_budget_exceeded.message: document observation data limit exceeded; some details were not retained

state_no_report_desc.message: There are no observations for this document yet. If the page was opened before observation was enabled, reload it.

state_sw_unavailable_desc.message: The extension background process did not answer. Close and reopen this window; if the error persists, restart the extension.

empty_no_findings.message: No findings in the observed area for this period

empty_no_findings_hint.message: This is not a site safety assessment. Check the observed area above.

techniques_none.message: No techniques were observed in the accessible area.

card_api_use_canvas_text.message: Canvas text measurement or drawing calls — $COUNT$

card_api_use_attempt_only.message: Attempt only: the call threw, no result was returned to the page

card_api_use_generic_note.message: An API call by itself is ordinary and does not prove tracking.

card_api_use_purpose.message: In general this mechanism can be used to recognise a browser.

card_purpose_local_probe.message: Local connections can support ordinary application integrations or checks for local services. The page’s purpose is not established.

card_purpose_dns.message: In general such a series can be used to test the DNS resolver.

card_fp_generic.message: The call sequence looks like fingerprint construction

card_fp_canvas_sequence.message: A series of reads after drawing text looks like fingerprint construction

card_fp_math_sequence.message: A series of numeric checks looks like a known pattern

card_fp_local_probe.message: A series of attempts to different ports on the same local address resembles port scanning.

inspector_local_probe_desc.message: Attempts to contact local addresses or ports were observed. A single attempt does not establish scanning. These observations do not show whether a port is open or a service was reached.

card_fp_dns_pattern.message: A series of requests to unique subdomains was observed; this happens in DNS tests. The resolver used is unknown to the extension.

card_fp_webrtc.message: The page used WebRTC. This mechanism can access network information.

card_fp_not_proven.message: Purpose, uniqueness and transmission of the result are not established by this observation.

card_fp_insufficient.message: Not enough data for a conclusion

card_vendor_purpose.message: Service purpose: $PURPOSE$. This is not a site safety assessment.

card_vendor_purpose_generic.message: bot protection, risk assessment or identification

card_vendor_match_weak_signal.message: integration element found (weak signal, may be spoofed by the page)

card_vendor_not_linked.message: A link between this service and other observations on the page is not established.

card_vendor_resource_note.message: The match concerns a requested resource. It does not prove that the service's code ran or caused the observed API calls.

card_vendor_no_trust.message: A recognised service is not a site safety assessment and does not mean this service performs all checks.

integrity_page_controlled.message: Data from the page context, may be spoofed

evidence_page_hook.message: API hook in the page context

attribution_sampled_stack.message: Call source from a stack sample (may be misleading)

action_pause.message: Pause observation in the current document

action_reload.message: Reload to analyse from the start

export_preview_desc.message: Only the fields below are included (redacted). Full URLs, cookie values, API results and input contents are absent.

export_host_warning.message: The file contains the page host: $HOST$. Do not share it unnecessarily.

export_document_changed.message: The document changed. Open the preview again.

export_unavailable.message: Export unavailable: no access to the page or no report.

export_not_implemented.message: The background process does not support export preview yet.

mode_off_desc.message: Background observation is off. No reports are created.

mode_active_tab_desc.message: Observations after activation; early calls may have been missed.

mode_site_desc.message: Early calls in permitted documents on the next load; third-party network may be partially visible.

mode_all_desc.message: Broadest access, without promising full coverage of workers, DNS or server-side logic.

scope_permission_denied.message: Permission was not granted. The scope is unchanged.

scope_permission_granted_reload.message: Access granted. Reload the page to analyse from the start.

scope_site_host_unknown.message: The host of the current page is unknown: enable “Check from now on” first or enter the host in settings.

scope_host_invalid.message: Enter a host, for example example.com

scope_granted_all.message: Broad site access has been granted by the browser.

scope_applied_reload.message: Observation scope updated. Reload the page to start observing from page load.

onboarding_limits.message: Default monitoring preserves API results. Optional API blocking is disabled until you explicitly enable it and can break websites. Wrappers remain detectable and add execution time; full coverage is not promised.

onboarding_no_server.message: The extension does not send analysis results and does not contact the developer's servers.

options_clear_session_desc.message: Deletes all document reports from session memory. Settings are kept.

options_clear_unavailable.message: This action is not available in this build yet.

inventory_session.message: Document reports live only in session memory (chrome.storage.session). After 10 minutes of inactivity, data is deleted on the next extension event, with checks at most once every 30 seconds, not at exactly 10 minutes. Closing the tab also triggers deletion; restarting the browser clears the session.

inventory_local.message: Settings and your Antidetect, Proxy, Firewall and Autosurfer data stay in chrome.storage.local and in extension databases on this computer until you delete them; the full list is in the privacy policy.

inventory_never.message: Never stored: audio samples, Math arguments and results, full URLs, request headers and bodies, keystrokes, form text, or client and peer IP addresses. Canvas/WebGL images remain in memory only. Configured ICE server endpoints use separate limited session storage. During a Pro recording, outgoing cookie names and values and the values of a fixed list of technical request headers are stored locally for the report.

inventory_export.message: Light Mode (JSON): The export file contains only the fields shown in its preview. The page host is excluded unless you explicitly include it; images and WebRTC connection details are not exported.

inventory_sync.message: Browser account sync, analytics and telemetry are not used, and nothing is sent to the developer. Network requests happen only when you start them (Cloudflare zone connection, geolocation lookups you turned on, your proxy and companion, proxy checks, Autosurfer), plus the automatic loading of the icons of pages in scope; see the privacy policy.

inventory_link.message: Full inventory: docs/data-inventory.md in the project repository.

sources_none.message: The third-party host list is not available in this report projection. Network events are visible only with permission for both the site and the request source.

error_not_found.message: Report not found: the document may have changed

error_stale_revision.message: The report changed, the action was cancelled

error_document_mismatch.message: The document changed, the action was cancelled

error_unavailable.message: The background process did not respond

scope_active_tab_toolbar.message: To start observing the current tab, open the extension using its Chrome toolbar button and select “Check from now on”.

export_include_host.message: Include the page host in the export:

vendors_catalog_unavailable.message: The service catalog is disabled: service recognition was not performed.

limitation_page_controlled_evidence.message: These observations come from the page context and can be forged by the page.

limitation_purpose_unknown.message: The purpose of the API calls is unknown.

limitation_uniqueness_not_established.message: The uniqueness and stability of the results were not tested.

limitation_readback_attempted_failed.message: At least one read attempt threw an exception; this does not establish a successful read.

limitation_uncalibrated_threshold.message: Rule thresholds have not yet been calibrated against a corpus of examples.

limitation_coverage_incomplete.message: Observation coverage is incomplete; some calls may have been missed.

limitation_catalog_disabled.message: The service catalog is disabled; links between observations and vendors were not checked.

limitation_text_ops_undifferentiated.message: Text measurement and drawing are counted together; their separate counts are unknown.

limitation_no_time_window.message: Counters cover the document lifetime and do not show activity within a separate short interval.

alternative_high_volume_rendering.message: A large number of text operations can also occur during ordinary editing or chart rendering.

coverage_flag_network_limited.message: network observations are limited by available permissions

coverage_flag_frames_inaccessible.message: observation of some frames is limited or not yet confirmed

badge_tooltip.message: Observed techniques in this tab and its frames: $N$

coverage_sensor_disabled_desc.message: Sensor $SENSOR$ is disabled ($REASON$). Calls to these APIs are not observed.

card_vendor_first_party.message: Vendor signature observed on an endpoint of the site's own domain

options_diagnostics_desc.message: Versions and background availability only. Page addresses and report data are excluded.

frame_limit_hint.message: Only the first 128 documents are listed. More embedded pages may be present.

visual_consent.message: Supported images already read by the page are captured automatically during the first 60 seconds of observation. Images stay in memory and are excluded from reports and exports.

visual_reload_scope.message: To capture a page-load check, first choose persistent observation for this site.

visual_waiting.message: Waiting for a supported Canvas or WebGL image read by the page. Reload the page to repeat its own check. Images read before observation began cannot be recovered; an empty preview does not mean there were no checks.

visual_untrusted.message: Source: page-controlled pixels. The page can alter this image; an image alone does not establish fingerprinting or site safety.

visual_decode_error.message: The received image could not be displayed. Its format or dimensions are unsupported.

inspector_other_documents_desc.message: Open a row to view that document. Counts, images and exports remain separate.

inspector_other_documents_limit.message: This overview checks the first $N$ other documents. Use the document selector to inspect additional frames.

inspector_clientrects_desc.message: Rectangle and size measurements can support fingerprinting and ordinary page layout. These counters do not establish their purpose. Exact coordinates are not retained.

inspector_api_family_desc.message: The API list describes a family. These counters do not distinguish individual methods or properties or establish the purpose of the calls.

inspector_display_desc.message: Screen, window and monitor information requests. Selected technical results are retained locally during Pro recording. A request does not establish access to the monitor list.

inspector_cpu_desc.message: hardwareConcurrency provides a browser estimate of available logical processors. Selected technical results are retained locally during Pro recording. The number of physical CPU cores is not determined.

inspector_memory_desc.message: Device Memory provides an approximate memory category rather than the exact installed RAM. Selected technical results are retained locally during Pro recording.

inspector_performance_desc.message: Timers and Performance APIs support benchmarks, animation and analytics. Selected technical results are retained locally during Pro recording. These observations do not establish their purpose.

rtc_scope_note.message: Only this document and the observed interval. Connections before the hooks or in inaccessible contexts may be missing.

rtc_created_unknown.message: Construction of this object was not observed.

rtc_closed_retained.message: close() was observed. This record is retained after closure.

rtc_connected_observed.message: A connected state was observed for this connection.

rtc_connected_unobserved.message: A connected state was not observed.

rtc_server_candidate.message: ICE candidate gathered via this server

rtc_server_error.message: ICE gathering error for this server

rtc_servers_unknown.message: No server details were observed. This does not establish that no servers were configured or used.

rtc_servers_limited.message: Server details are incomplete; at most 8 endpoints are retained per connection.

rtc_evidence_note.message: Configured does not mean contacted. A candidate or gathering error does not establish the selected route or data transmission. Connection state applies to the connection as a whole. These details remain page controlled.

rtc_empty.message: No connection details are available for this document and interval. API counters may still contain observations.

rtc_capture_limited.message: Connection history is incomplete. Omitted objects: $N$; capture limits may also omit updates.

rtc_export_note.message: This separate local history is retained for up to 10 minutes without history updates. Viewing it does not extend retention. Server and connection details are not included in JSON export.

inspector_webrtc_desc.message: WebRTC API calls were observed. These APIs also support ordinary audio/video calls and data exchange; the calls alone do not establish fingerprinting or IP address disclosure.

card_purpose_webrtc.message: WebRTC supports audio/video communication and data exchange. These observations do not establish the purpose of these calls.

inspector_script_unknown.message: Unknown — this report identifies the document, not the calling script.

inspector_empty.message: No supported technique has been observed in this document yet. Reload a page that was already open when the extension was installed.

inspector_image_waiting.message: Waiting for a supported image read by this page. Earlier or very early inline reads and oversized images may be missed; reload the page to repeat its own check.

language_change_failed.message: The language could not be saved. Please try again.

mode_save_error.message: This view preference could not be saved. It may reset when you reopen the extension.

pro_pdf_hint.message: Open the report to review it, or save it as a PDF using the browser print dialog.

pro_pdf_error.message: Could not open the report preview. Please try again.

pro_start_note.message: Records pages visited on this site in this tab and related tabs for up to 10 minutes. Recording continues when this window is closed. Earlier activity is not recovered; reload the page after starting to observe its loading checks. During a Pro recording, outgoing cookie names and values and the values of a fixed list of technical request headers are stored locally for the report.

pro_replace_note.message: Starting a new recording replaces the previous session. Save its report first if needed.

pro_unavailable.message: Recording cannot start on this page. Open an accessible HTTP or HTTPS site with observation enabled.

pro_other_domain.message: This page is outside the recording domain. Its activity is not added to this session.

pro_pages_empty.message: No page visits have been recorded yet.

pro_no_techniques.message: No supported API technique was recorded for this visit. This does not establish that no checks took place.

pro_limits_note.message: Coverage depends on page access and supported sensors. API use and loaded resources do not establish tracking, code execution or site safety. Sensitive request contents and images are excluded from this report.

pro_stop_access_revoked.message: Recording stopped because page access was revoked.

pro_stop_storage_error.message: Recording stopped because session data could not be saved. The retained report may be incomplete.

pro_stop_limit.message: A recording data limit was reached. The retained report is incomplete.

report_print_hint.message: Choose “Save as PDF” in the browser print dialog. The PDF contains the report shown below.

report_recording.message: Running recordings cannot be exported. Stop the recording first.

report_unavailable.message: This recording is no longer available.

report_map_note.message: Links show resource requests observed during each page visit. They do not establish ownership, a direct script dependency or proof of data transmission.

inventory_pro.message: Pro Mode separately records sanitized page URLs, titles, resource metadata, detector results, the names and values of Cookie headers and the values of a fixed list of technical request headers of recorded requests for up to 10 minutes. The local session remains until replacement, clearing or browser-session end, and a saved report can stay in a local database until you delete it. Its PDF includes the analyzed domain and visible report details, including cookie values. The Light/Pro view preference is saved locally.

proxy_workspace_direct_domains_detail.message: Sites in this list connect without the proxy: they see your real IP address, and their names are resolved by your usual DNS.

proxy_workspace_protect_webrtc_detail.message: WebRTC then works only through TURN servers over TCP via the proxy, so calls on some sites may not connect.

proxy_workspace_tcp_fingerprint_detail.message: The TCP/IP fingerprint (p0f) that sites see belongs to whatever opens the connection: the proxy server for SOCKS5, HTTP, HTTPS and VLESS, the companion’s own network stack for OpenVPN. The extension does not change it.

protection_webrtc_proxy_only_note.message: Sends every WebRTC connection through the proxy and nothing directly. Calls and video chats fail if no proxy carries UDP. Firefox only.

proxy_workspace_http_detail.message: HTTP proxy. Without a login the browser connects to it directly; with a login the companion relays the connection and sends Basic authentication (Digest and NTLM are not supported). The proxy sees the host name of every connection. The path to an HTTP proxy is not encrypted: anyone on it can read the login and, for plain HTTP sites, the pages.

proxy_workspace_https_detail.message: HTTPS proxy: the connection to the proxy itself is encrypted and its certificate is checked. Without a login the browser connects to it directly; with a login the companion relays the connection and sends Basic authentication (Digest and NTLM are not supported). The proxy still sees the host name of every connection.

proxy_workspace_http_relay_detail.message: With a login, every site (including plain HTTP ones) reaches the proxy through the companion as a CONNECT tunnel; some proxies refuse CONNECT to port 80. Connecting only checks that the proxy answers (for HTTPS also its certificate): the login is verified by the first request or by “Check connection”.

proxy_workspace_companion_notice_title.message: Some proxy types need extra software

proxy_workspace_companion_notice.message: VLESS, OpenVPN, and SOCKS5, HTTP or HTTPS proxies with a login need a small companion program for Windows. It is a separate download from GitHub; the extension never downloads or installs it. Extract the archive and run the installer. SOCKS5, HTTP and HTTPS proxies without a login work without it.
